reviewer_composition.description: Four AI reviews across three model families: two Luna, one Terra, and one Sol.

reviewers.scope: scientific methods, source semantics, derivations, gaps, and 249-entity mapping boundary
key_findings: All deterministic CCI compiler, derivation, mapping, source-registry, and public-boundary checks passed.
GCB fossil and land-use accounting remain separate; WPP projection identity, Ember gap semantics, and CCKP model/reanalysis semantics are disclosed.
No live publisher re-fetch was performed in this read-only review; verification was against pinned receipts, exact artifacts, and fixtures.

reviewers.scope: source rights, attribution, provenance, and globe assets
key_findings: GCB, WPP, Ember, and CCKP have credible open licence bases with attribution and transformation-disclosure obligations.
Natural Earth geometry has a favorable public-domain basis and NASA Black Marble has official byte-pinned provenance with attribution and no-endorsement conditions.
The Three-Globe example starfield, blue-marble, and topology images have package provenance but no established underlying image-rights basis.

reviewers.scope: runtime, accessibility, fallback parity, cache atomicity, and reproducibility
key_findings: CCI contract, public fail-closed boundary, release-profile, WebGL fallback, public copy, syntax, and load-order checks passed.
The accessible fallback exposed 249 records, exact Carbon and Power partitions, keyboard focus, compact controls, and no 320px horizontal overflow.
The fallback needs an explicit public review-state disclosure, and the exact staged WebGL lane requires a final browser run.

reviewers.scope: independent red-team of scientific, rights, runtime, and deployment-gate claims
key_findings: The concept of a narrowly scoped, separately labeled AI-reviewed source-data lane is defensible; the pinned current tree is not approved as-is.
The three ambiguous images must be absent from staged bytes and all executable, preload, and service-worker references.
The new lane must not weaken or claim to satisfy the existing human-signature production gate.

agreed_scientific_boundary.public_label: AI-reviewed source-data release — source observations, estimates, modeled projections, and disclosed deterministic derivations; no human review or legal certification.

required_conditions: Remove the three excluded Three-Globe images from staged public output and every executable, preload, service-worker, and runtime reference.
Add negative staged checks for the excluded paths, filenames, hashes, and URLs.
Retain exact Natural Earth and NASA bytes, sources, attribution, historical context, and limitations.
Bind all four complete AI reports and the final post-mitigation file hashes in the publication artifact.
Publish human_review=false and legal_certification=false; never claim independent human scientific review, certification, or rights clearance.
Create a separate AI-factual profile without changing the semantics of the existing human-reviewed and signed production gate.
Exclude the inverted carbon-relief experiment from the public AI-factual profile.
Keep every value's evidence class, period, scope, uncertainty, transformation, and provenance visible.
Run exact staged integrity, accessibility, full browser smoke, rollback, strict CI, and Cloudflare deployment checks on the final digest.
authority_note: This prepublication artifact records AI review evidence and conditions. It does not itself authorize deployment or satisfy the repository's existing human-signature release gate.
